msg: Firstly it is better not to miss a go at all. I mainly based my guesses on length of hat. I started with the tall hat gnome which was well and when that went below 3 mushrooms I would switch to the shorter hat gnome. If this went below 3 mushrooms I would switch back to the taller hat gnome i.e pick a length of hat and stick to it if it provides you with a lot of mushrooms in a row and then switch when you get lower mushrooms. At the beginning I found the taller hat gnome gave me more mushrooms and at the end I found it was the shorter hat gnome.
